V2 agentic RAG endpoint with server-side filter resolution.

The agent dynamically selects which nexsets to query, calls the appropriate
search tools, and generates a response with optional SSE streaming.

Filters are resolved by combining ``user_context`` (access_rules,
access_scope, filters) with per-nexset registered filter schemas.
Register or replace the full filter schema for a nexset.

patch.description:
Update a nexset's title, description, and/or documentation.

name/description are written via ``PUT /data_sets/{id}``; documentation
is written via ``POST /data_sets/{id}/docs`` with the full docs list
after replacing the last record's ``text``. Cache invalidation
(dataset_info, filter_schema, normalization_map) is scheduled iff at
least one Admin API write succeeded — even on a partial failure, so a

Run the tool_metrics periodic rollup for the given lookback window.

Same shape as gateway.py's trigger_vendor_sync: org-allowlist gated,

schema.title: Response Refresh Tool Metrics V1 Mcpaas Admin Metrics Refresh Post

get.description:
Who has hit this MCP server, and what happened on each call.

``server_key`` is the customer-facing identifier (the one baked into an
MCP client's actual connection URL) — resolved to a toolset exactly like
real MCP traffic is (mirrors mcp/server.py). ``environment`` (default
``"prod"``) disambiguates which of that toolset's environments to show,
since one toolset can have more than one simultaneously-active export
(e.g. dev + prod) — see 035/036's migration comments.

``limit``/``offset`` paginate sessions (most recently active first);
``from``/``to`` filter each session's calls by receipt ``created_at``.
``range`` (``1h``/``24h``/``7d``/``30d``) is the window for the separate
``metrics`` summary/top-tools blob, built from the tool_metrics rollup
table rather than from the sessions/calls above. Each ``top_tools`` entry
carries its own ``health`` status inline (no separate top-level list to
re-join by tool_id). ``granularity`` (``15m``/``1h``/``1d``) still governs
the internal bucket width used for ``peak_bucket``/``avg_calls_per_hour``
— not every pair is valid (e.g. ``15m`` over ``30d`` would require
thousands of internal points), see metrics_service.resolve_granularity;
an invalid pair is a 422, not a 500. ``top_n`` caps ``top_tools``
(remainder rolled into one "other" row).

schema.title: Response Get Server Activity V1 Mcpaas Servers  Server Key  Activity Get

get.description:
What this client has done, across servers and sessions.

``client_id`` is an OAuth DCR identifier, not org-scoped on its own (DCR
registration precedes org resolution — see mcp/auth.py), so the query
always filters client_id together with org_id, never client_id alone.

``limit``/``offset`` paginate receipts, not sessions — a session's
``calls`` here may reflect only part of its history if it spans a page.

schema.title: Response Get Client Activity V1 Mcpaas Clients  Client Id  Activity Get

get.description:
What this subject has done, across servers and sessions.

``subject_id`` is populated for every auth method (unlike client_id,
OAuth-only) but is caller-asserted, not verified, and just as not
org-scoped on its own — same filtering/pagination caveats as
get_client_activity above.

schema.title: Response Get Subject Activity V1 Mcpaas Subjects  Subject Id  Activity Get

AccessScope.title: AccessScope
AccessScope.description:
Who may invoke a toolset's tools.

Unlike the other enums here this one is *enforced*: the MCP request gate
reads it before resolving tools, and it is the first owner-aware predicate
in MCPaaS (``owner_id`` was previously stamped but never gated on).

This governs *access*, not identity. Every permitted caller runs as themselves:
``runtime_config.credential`` auto-resolution fetches credentials with the caller's
own session token and picks their latest match for the connector, so a shared
toolset needs no per-user setup. A caller with no credential for the connector gets
an actionable ``credential_required`` result instead.

AgenticRagEmbeddingConfig.title: AgenticRagEmbeddingConfig
AgenticRagEmbeddingConfig.description: Embedding config for the V2 agentic endpoint.

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for OpenAI reasoning models (gpt-5*). Controls how much the model thinks. Defaults to 'low' when unset.

reasoning_summary.title: Reasoning Summary
reasoning_summary.description: Reasoning summary verbosity for OpenAI reasoning models. Controls how much of the chain-of-thought is streamed back as thinking_delta events. 'detailed' produces visibly streaming multi-paragraph summaries. Defaults to 'concise' when unset.

AgenticRagLLMConfig.title: AgenticRagLLMConfig
AgenticRagLLMConfig.description:
LLM config for the V2 agentic endpoint — only credential_id is required.

Model and provider are inferred from the credential when not provided.

AgenticRagMode.title: AgenticRagMode
AgenticRagMode.description:
Execution mode for ``POST /v2/agentic-rag``.

Controls reasoning depth, agent-loop turn budget, and model selection
(instant prefers ``slm_config`` when provided; thinking / deep_research
always use ``llm_config``).

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Optional additional request-specific system instructions appended to the V2 agent system prompt for this request only.

nexsets.title: Nexsets
nexsets.description: List of nexset IDs to query.

user_context.description: User identity, access rules, scope, and page filters.

reranker_config.description: Optional reranker credential configuration. When provided, Pinecone-backed nexset search tools over-fetch candidates and rerank them via Cohere before returning the top_k chunks.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: When true, attach a ``profile`` block on the response with per-phase durations, per-tool latency aggregate, and per-iteration LLM timing. Non-streaming only — requests with ``stream=true`` and ``profile=true`` are rejected with 422.

skip_cache.title: Skip Cache
skip_cache.description: Bypass V2 execution caches for this request.

cache_policy.description: Cache behavior for supported V2 caches. 'default' reads and writes, 'refresh' fetches fresh data and overwrites, 'bypass' skips reads and writes. Legacy skip_cache=true takes precedence and maps to 'bypass'.

mode.description: Execution mode. Defaults to 'thinking' — llm_config with low reasoning effort and a 10-turn budget. 'instant' uses slm_config when provided (fallback to llm_config) with reasoning forced off — favors latency and cost; callers must opt in explicitly. 'deep_research' uses llm_config with high reasoning effort, an extended turn budget, and injects the deep_research_reasoning skill into the agent system prompt. Per-request llm_config.reasoning_effort and reasoning_summary override the mode defaults when set.

slm_config.description: INTERNAL FIELD — subject to change without notice. Not part of the public /v2/agentic-rag contract; do not rely on this field in external integrations. Optional Small Language Model credential configuration. Used by the main agent when mode='instant' and by v2-flow helper LLM callers (metadata normalization) regardless of mode. When absent and mode='instant', the main agent falls back to llm_config with reasoning forced off.

AgenticRagRequest.title: AgenticRagRequest
AgenticRagRequest.description: Request model for the V2 agentic RAG endpoint (``POST /v2/agentic-rag``).

credential_id.title: Credential Id
credential_id.description: Credential ID for the Cohere reranker.

model.title: Model
model.description: Cohere reranking model identifier (e.g., 'rerank-v4.0-pro'). Required — no default is applied so that callers are explicit about model selection.

top_k_multiplier.title: Top K Multiplier
top_k_multiplier.description: Per-request override for the Pinecone over-fetch multiplier. When unset, falls back to V2_RERANKER_TOP_K_MULTIPLIER (default 2).

rank_fields.title: Rank Fields
rank_fields.description: Ordered list of fields to include in the JSON document string sent to Cohere for each chunk. Defaults to ['title', 'summary', 'text', 'metadata']. Cohere v2 rerank accepts plain strings only, so multi-field signal is packed into a labeled JSON object per chunk. Fields absent on a chunk are silently omitted from its document string.

AgenticRagRerankerConfig.title: AgenticRagRerankerConfig
AgenticRagRerankerConfig.description:
Reranker config for the V2 agentic endpoint.

Presence of this field enables Cohere reranking inside Pinecone-backed
search tools. The tool over-fetches ``top_k_multiplier × top_k`` candidates
from Pinecone, reranks via Cohere, and returns the top ``top_k``.

SkillPatchRequest.title: SkillPatchRequest
SkillPatchRequest.description:
Request body for ``PATCH /v2/orgs/{org_id}/skills/{skill_id}`` (Nexla ops).

Partial update: any subset of the fields below may be supplied; those left
``None`` are not written. Lets ops disable a skill or bump ``version``
without re-sending the full ``content`` markdown. The handler rejects a
fully empty payload with 400.

SkillUpsertRequest.title: SkillUpsertRequest
SkillUpsertRequest.description:
Request body for ``PUT /v2/orgs/{org_id}/skills/{skill_id}`` (Nexla ops).

Full replace: ``content`` and ``version`` are required, so toggling
``enabled`` or bumping ``version`` alone still means re-sending the whole
row. Use ``PATCH`` (``SkillPatchRequest``) for partial edits.

input.title: Input
input.description: Input JSON object with base64-encoded image (if mode='image') or JSON object containing text (if mode='text'), Endpoint can also allow for a string input

output_structure.title: Output Structure
output_structure.description: Expected structured output format. If not provided, a best-guess structure will be generated.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Filter mode: 'include' syncs only matching tools, 'exclude' syncs all except matching.

tool_names.title: Tool Names
tool_names.description: Exact original tool names (as reported by the remote MCP server) to match.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.description: Glob patterns matched against original tool names. Supported wildcards: '*' matches any sequence of characters, '?' matches exactly one character. Bracket expressions like '[abc]' are NOT supported. Examples: 'github_*', '*_readonly', 'tool_?'.

ToolFilterIn.title: ToolFilterIn
ToolFilterIn.description:
Optional filter for selecting a subset of tools from an external MCP server.

When ``mode`` is ``"include"``, only tools matching ``tool_names`` or
``patterns`` are synced.  When ``mode`` is ``"exclude"``, all tools
*except* those matching are synced.

access_scope.description: Who may invoke this toolset's tools. 'private' restricts it to the creator; 'organization' (default) allows any member of the org; 'public' allows any authenticated Nexla user. For both shared scopes non-owners must map their own credential before a tool call succeeds.

refresh_tools.title: Refresh Tools
refresh_tools.description: When true, re-fetch upstream nexset metadata for any nexset-derived tool in tool_ids and update the local tool row before associating it with the new toolset. Per-tool refresh failures are reported in the response and do not abort toolset creation.
